official_sources.evidence: VDOE publishes annual VQB5 quality/location and participation workbooks with distinct program-year and measurement semantics.
VQB5 is Virginia's birth-to-five quality measurement and improvement system, not a real-time census of all active licensed businesses.
Virginia provides a consumer pathway for finding child care; the human-facing search is not treated as an unattended bulk contract.

The documented policy permits non-commercial downloads with notices retained and requires written permission for commercial use; this discovery does not decide the intended-use classification or obtain permission.

scope.warning: Administrator-reported location/contact information, verified ratings, participation eligibility, licensing, and current operation are separate assertions and observation periods.

temporal.limitation: The two published workbooks cover different program years and meanings and cannot be merged into a single current-status assertion.

next_action: Resolve intended-use and permission applicability before downloading workbooks. If authorized, validate bounded workbook metadata and person-safe schema, preserve program years and rating/participation/license semantics separately, and establish stable keys and row conservation before connector or production admission.
